one_line: Khokhar clan leaders who rose in revolt during the Ghurid crisis in Punjab, 1204–1206 CE.

appearance.age_look: early 30s, lean but strong, outdoors-hardened build
appearance.face: Oval face with a sharp jawline, wheatish-brown complexion, high cheekbones, straight nose; faint sun-creases at the eyes, a thin healed scar on the left eyebrow; default expression calm but alert, with a quiet, resolute focus.
appearance.hair: Thick straight black hair gathered into a mid-length knot at the back of the head, covered by a deep-red woollen turban wrapped flat and low with a narrow brown leather headband over it, and a short, neatly trimmed black moustache and beard kept close to the face.
appearance.costume: He wears a long, knee-length quilted cotton kurta in muted indigo with vertical stitching lines, over a pale-cream, tighter under-tunic, and loose off-white cotton churidar-style trousers tucked into mid-calf brown leather boots; a dark-forest-green woollen shawl is wrapped tightly across his shoulders and chest and belted at the waist with a wide brown leather belt fitted with simple bronze rings; over this, a sleeveless, dark-brown leather brigandine-style vest with visible small metal rivets suggests light armour; around his neck a plain bronze amulet disc hangs on a cord, and his wrists have two simple plaited leather bracelets.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved single-edged steel sword of early Indo-Iranian form, with a plain iron crossguard, a narrow leather-wrapped grip, and a rounded bronze pommel, carried in a simple brown leather scabbard slung from his belt and often held resting over his shoulder.

ref_desc: Raisal and Bhikan Khokhar are shown as a single lean, wheatish warrior with an oval face, low deep-red turban over a black hair knot, trimmed beard, indigo quilted kurta, forest-green shawl, brown leather vest and boots, and a curved steel sword in a brown scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of a single Khokhar clan leader from early 13th-century Punjab, representing Raisal and Bhikan as one figure: a lean, early-30s warrior with a wheatish-brown oval face, high cheekbones, a straight nose, a thin scar on his left eyebrow, and a neatly trimmed black moustache and beard giving a calm but alert expression. His thick black hair is tied in a mid-length knot and covered by a low-wrapped deep-red woollen turban secured with a narrow brown leather headband. He wears a knee-length, quilted indigo cotton kurta with visible vertical stitching over a pale-cream under-tunic, loose off-white cotton trousers, and mid-calf brown leather boots. A forest-green woollen shawl crosses his shoulders and chest and is cinched by a wide brown leather belt with simple bronze rings, over which sits a sleeveless dark-brown leather brigandine-style vest dotted with small rivets. Add a plain bronze disc amulet on a cord at his neck and two simple plaited leather bracelets on his wrists. His signature weapon is a slightly curved single-edged steel sword with a plain iron crossguard, leather-wrapped grip, and rounded bronze pommel in a brown leather scabbard on his belt, sometimes held resting over his shoulder; use an earthy palette of indigo blue, deep red, forest green, off-white, and brown leather, and show him from multiple angles to emphasize this exact face, hair, clothing, and sword.
